<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak, a relatively strong M+1 peak (~17 % of the base peak), and a much weaker M+2 peak (~1.6 % of the base peak)—the only element whose natural isotopic distribution can be confidently inferred is carbon (13C contributes the M+1 envelope). No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present. Therefore the definitively identified element is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
